name: breadcrumbs
title: Breadcrumbs
description: Shows where a page sits in a hierarchy, collapsing middle levels into a menu when long.

when: Pages nested two or more levels deep.

instead.when: One way back to the parent page is enough.
The levels are steps of a flow.

builtIn: A navigation landmark; the current page has aria-current.
youProvide: With children: a textValue on a Breadcrumb whose label is not plain text, for the folded menu.

genui.description: The path to the current page. items are {label, href?}; the last item is the current page.

items.description:
From the section root ("Projects"), never "Home", to the current page. Leave it out to compose `Breadcrumb`s
as children instead.

Breadcrumbs.name: items
Breadcrumbs.description:
From the section root ("Projects"), never "Home", to the current page. Leave it out to compose `Breadcrumb`s
as children instead.

Breadcrumbs.name: children
Breadcrumbs.description: With no `items`: `Breadcrumb`s from the root to the current page (the last one).

Breadcrumbs.name: aria-label
Breadcrumbs.description: Names the navigation landmark; "Location" by default.

Breadcrumb.name: href
Breadcrumb.description: A page; leave it out on the last one, the current page.

Breadcrumb.name: children
Breadcrumb.description: The level's name. It may hold more than text; then give `textValue` for the folded "…" menu.

Breadcrumb.name: textValue
Breadcrumb.description: The words for the "…" menu when this level folds; the label itself when it is plain text.
